about: Test vectors for the X-Umbrella-Caller header, format v1. The value is "v1." followed by unpadded base64url of the UTF-8 bytes of `json`. `payload` is `json` parsed. `caller` is the gateway's request-scoped caller binding the value is built from (field names as in apps/backend/src/lib/metamcp/caller-context-store.ts). `user_id_header` is the X-Umbrella-User-Id value the gateway sends on the same request, or null. Vectors under `no_value` produce no X-Umbrella-Caller header. Only `uid` and `cred` identify the caller; `email`, `label` and `rid` are descriptive. For an OAuth client whose id is an https URL (a client metadata document client) `caller.oauthClientId` is that URL and `caller.oauthTokenFamilyId` is the access token's refresh-token family id; `cred` is then `oauth:cimd.` + the first 32 lowercase hex characters of the SHA-256 of the URL's UTF-8 bytes + `.` + the first 16 hex characters of the family id with its hyphens removed (see `url_client_credential`).

url_client_credential.applies_when: caller.authMethod is oauth, caller.oauthClientId does not match the oauth grammar above, and it matches ^https://\S+$ with at most 512 characters
url_client_credential.cred: oauth:cimd.<first 32 hex of sha256(url utf-8)>.<first 16 hex of family id without hyphens>
url_client_credential.no_value_when: the family id is missing or not a lowercase uuid, or the id is over 512 characters or not an https URL

vectors.name: API key, key owner, every descriptive field present
API key bound to act as another user: uid is that user, cred is the key
OAuth token: cred is the client the token was issued to
OAuth client id using every character class the grammar allows
OAuth client identified by a metadata URL: cred is cimd.<32 hex of sha256(url)>.<16 hex of the token family id>
same metadata URL, another token family: the URL half is the same and the family half differs
OAuth client metadata URL of exactly 512 characters is aliased
Inspector session: cred is session and the label names the Inspector
email, label and request id unknown are null
user id of exactly 64 characters
descriptive fields are trimmed
a blank label is null
non-ASCII label is sent as UTF-8
quotes and backslashes in a label are JSON-escaped
a label of exactly 200 code points is kept
a label over 200 code points is shortened to 199 plus an ellipsis
label length counts code points: 200 characters outside the BMP are kept
label length counts code points: 201 characters outside the BMP are shortened
a label with a control character is null
a label with a delete character is null
a label with a right-to-left override is null
a label with a zero-width space is null
a label with a line separator is null
a label with a paragraph separator is null
a label with an inner newline is null
a label with a lone surrogate is null
a label that is not a string is null
an email of exactly 254 code points is kept
an email over 254 code points is null, never shortened
an email with a control character is null
a request id over 64 code points is null, never shortened
a request id that is not a string is null

API key with no owner and no acts-as user

OAuth token with no client id
OAuth client id with a character outside the grammar

OAuth client metadata URL with no token family id
OAuth client metadata URL with a token family id that is not a lowercase uuid
OAuth client metadata URL over 512 characters
OAuth client id that is an http URL
OAuth client id with a slash that is not a URL
Inspector session with no user
unknown auth method
no auth method
user id with a character outside the grammar
